The reviewer will look at two things: whether the driver told you about the route change and you agreed to it before leaving the shortest route, and whether there was a real reason for the detour. They'll also see the distance you were billed for compared with the usual route.

You'll get a separate message about when to expect an answer. No action is needed from you now.

DRIVER: This dispute is going to a human reviewer rather than being decided automatically.

That's because of a chat message sent during the trip. When trip chat contains language that may be threatening or intimidating, we always hand the case to a person instead of ruling on it ourselves. The reviewer will look at whether the route change was mentioned to the rider and agreed to before leaving the shortest route, and whether there was a genuine reason for the detour — for example a road or traffic incident. Your account stays as it is for now.

You'll get a separate message about when to expect an answer. Nothing is needed from you right now.
